title: Replica symmetry breaking at arbitrary depth
summary: A Lean formalization of open phases with every prescribed finite replica symmetry breaking depth in mixed even-spin Ising models at zero external field and positive temperature. The first selected result constructs strictly increasing even degrees beginning at four and a nonempty open set of positive effective covariance coefficients, with an optimizing probability measure having exactly k+1 support points.
